source_name: NYC Department of Design and Construction press release index and linked official milestone pages
publisher: NYC Department of Design and Construction
source_type: official agency press release index and detail pages
coverage_years_checked: Targeted 2024, 2025, and 2026 DDC index entries within 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19.
granularity: Named public building, civic facility, cultural facility, library branch, resilience project, or public-realm capital milestone.
date_fields_observed: Press release index date and, where opened, detail-page date/milestone language.
geometry_fields_observed: Named facility, street address, park/project area, or neighborhood; no parcel polygon or authoritative project boundary was extracted in this scratch pass.
license_or_terms_note: NYC.gov terms of use apply: https://www.nyc.gov/home/terms-of-use.page. This scratch pack uses factual metadata only and retains publisher attribution, source URL, and retrieval date.
reliability: strong for official agency milestone dates and project names; usable with caveats for geometry because points are manually placed from facility addresses or named project areas.
required_caveats: Treat openings, reopenings, completions, groundbreakings, and approvals as source-reported milestones only.
Do not infer service outcomes, safety outcomes, climate-risk reduction, neighborhood effects, usage, occupancy, or causation from the milestone.
Groundbreaking and construction-start records are not completion records.
Representative points for linear/coastal/resilience work must be replaced by project polygons or linework before production use.
ingestion_recommendation: Candidate-review ready; promote only after URL-level duplicate checks against DDC, library, resilience, and public-building packs and geometry replacement where applicable.

source_name: NYPL, Brooklyn Public Library, and Queens Public Library official press/news pages linked from DDC or library sites
source_type: official library press release/news page or DDC index link to official library page
coverage_years_checked: Targeted 2024-2026 branch opening and reopening milestones not sourced from SCA, DOB, HPD, LPC, Parks tracker, or PDC packs.
geographic_scope: New York City public library branches in Brooklyn, Queens, Manhattan, Bronx, and Staten Island where found.
date_fields_observed: Official page date or DDC index date for linked official library pages.
geometry_fields_observed: Branch address/name; geometry is approximate branch address point.
license_or_terms_note: Library website terms/copyright apply. This scratch pack uses brief factual metadata, source URLs, and attribution only.
reliability: strong for branch opening/reopening milestones; not a construction-permit or occupancy source.
required_caveats: Branch reopening does not prove all construction scopes are complete unless explicitly stated.
Facility opening does not imply library usage, access equity, educational outcomes, or causal neighborhood impacts.
ingestion_recommendation: Useful supplement to agency capital pages; dedupe against earlier library and DDC scratch packs before import.

source_name: NYCEDC and NYC Health + Hospitals official resilience and public-facility pages
publisher: NYC Economic Development Corporation and NYC Health + Hospitals
source_type: official public authority/municipal health system press release
coverage_years_checked: Targeted official resilience/public building milestones through 2026-05-19.
date_fields_observed: Press release date and title/body milestone language.
geometry_fields_observed: Hospital campus, waterfront segment, or named project area; representative point only in this scratch pass.
license_or_terms_note: Official publisher site terms apply; retain factual metadata, URL, attribution, and retrieval date.
reliability: strong for official milestone dates; geometry and outcome interpretation require caveats.
required_caveats: Floodwall or resilience milestone pages do not prove avoided damage, health outcomes, or causal climate benefits.
Campus/project-area point geometry is not an engineering boundary.
Some EDC pages are summary pages; verify detail pages before production import.
ingestion_recommendation: Use as documented observed-change candidates with strict non-causal language and follow-up geometry work.
